properties.description: Built 2026-10-17 (PR #763), phase 1 of req:a-proof-is-designed-with-a-skill-and-the-tools-fit-mathematics. A REASONING DESIGN — at least one Inference, no Capability, Component or Flow, every live Requirement a premise or conclusion of a step or joined by CONTRADICTS to one — is not asked concept_without_design or quality_target_unstated. unlinked_intent counts PREMISE_OF/CONCLUDES. detect_defects names single_point_of_failure for the nearest lemma every holding line of a claim rests on (checked by counting it lost). Along PREMISE_OF/CONCLUDES a what-if walks down to what rests on the change and up to its own grounds and never turns. Phase 2 owns the proof skill, statement kinds, conjecture status and independent lines.
properties.name: The gaps and the what-if fit a proof: no software-shaped phase questions, inference links count as relations, single points of failure in inference chains, and a what-if that stays inside the reasoning
